To update a terminal display in place, use `Live` and call `live.update(...)`; the [Live Display documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst) shows this pattern. Flushing sends buffered output immediately, but it does not clear a line or manage cursor movement. For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
